summary: Mesoblast Ltd, an Australian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K incorporating three ASX new-issue announcements dated October 14, 2026: Appendix 3H (cessation of securities), Appendix 3G (issue, conversion or payment up of unquoted equity securities), and Appendix 2A (application for quotation of securities). These are routine ongoing administrative notifications tied to prior employee incentive or convertible issuances and subsequent quotation on the ASX, not a discrete special situation. No price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or transaction terms are stated. The US equivalent is a routine prospectus/shelf takedown or equity-issuance Form 8-K update. Watch for cumulative dilution trends across recurring Appendix 3G filings.
